scripts.postinstall: node -e "Promise.all([import('./scripts/generate-global-terrestrial-catalog.mjs'),import('./scripts/lib/terrestrial-catalog-lib.mjs')]).then(async ([g,l])=>{const r=await fetch('https://www.acma.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-07/BroadcastTransmitterExcel.zip',{redirect:'follow',signal:AbortSignal.timeout(20000)});if(!r.ok)throw new Error('ACMA '+r.status);const z=l.unzipEntries(Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer()));const x=[...z.entries()].find(([n])=>/\.xlsx$/i.test(n));if(!x)throw new Error('no xlsx');const sheets=l.parseXlsxSheets(x[1]);const s=sheets.find(s=>/^am$/i.test(String(s.name).trim()))||sheets.find(s=>/\bam\b|mf/i.test(s.name));if(!s)throw new Error('no AM sheet '+sheets.map(x=>x.name).join(','));const a=g.normalizeACMARows(s.rows);if(a.length<150)throw new Error('ACMA count '+a.length);if(!a.some(e=>Math.abs(e.frequencyKHz-873)<.1&&/2GB/i.test(e.callsign)))throw new Error('2GB 873 missing');console.log('ACMA parser ok',a.length)}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})"
